gloss: to be caught, to hold on

definitions.gloss: to be caught, to be arrested
to hold on, to grab onto

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}が{捕|つか}まった。

examples.english: To hold on to the handrail.

examples.japanese: タクシーが{捕|つか}まらない。

notes:
{捕|つか}まる means to be caught or hold on.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {捕|つか}まる (intransitive): to be caught
- {捕|つか}まえる (transitive): to catch

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {捕|つか}まる: to be caught
- {掴|つか}まる: to hold onto
